source.author: lucan
source.text: Vel, cum tanta vocent discrimina Martis Iberi, Quid rapidum deflectis iter?
source.text_original: Vel, cum tanta vocent discrimina Martis Iberi, / Quid rapidum deflectis iter?
source.text_english: Or, when such great perils of Iberian war summon you, why do you turn aside your swift course?

reuse.author: val
reuse.text: ira maris vastique placent discrimina ponti.
reuse.text_original: ira maris vastique placent discrimina ponti.
reuse.text_english: The wrath of the sea and the perils of the vast deep delight them.
